parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no facility bans, no documented police targeting or border friction, and a documented local tradition of accepted third-gender community. The negatives are largely resident-facing (surgery-required LGR, no anti-discrimination statute, no hate-crime recognition, marriage bans) — climate signals, not visitor exposures. The social climate is conservative: low approval of same-sex marriage, organised religious opposition, and no national acceptance evidence outside one indigenous territory, which holds the score below the 0.75 anchors with full community acceptance. The dossier is thin on traveler-facing practice; absent documented targeting in a structured state with an LGR pathway, I extrapolate mild-to-moderate friction rather than hostility. Open questions (border handling, facility practice) are unanswered questions, not exposures. Reduced Risk.
